tui_config_problems_action_key_duplicate: key '{key}' is already used by action '{action}'
tui_config_problems_action_key_open_key: key '{key}' is already the open_key of service '{service}'

tui_config_problems_affected_task_unknow: '{task}' is not the label of any action
tui_config_problems_condition_completed: condition 'completed_successfully' needs services.{dependency}.command (nothing to run to completion)

tui_config_problems_deploy_keep_min: must be >= 2 (rollback needs a previous release)
tui_config_problems_deploy_link_key: key must be a release-relative path without '..'
tui_config_problems_deploy_link_value: value must be an absolute path
tui_config_problems_deploy_services_empt: at least one service is required
tui_config_problems_deploy_targets_empty: at least one target is required
tui_config_problems_key_builtin: key '{key}' is a built-in dashboard key
tui_config_problems_open_tunnel_without_: action '{action}' sets open_tunnel: true but there is no `tunnel:` block
tui_config_problems_ready_exclusive: set exactly one of `http` (path or URL) or `command`
tui_config_problems_remote_command: a remote service runs no local command: remove `command`
tui_config_problems_remote_port_missing: needs the service's local `port` (where atlas forwards it)
tui_config_problems_remote_ssh_invalid: '{ssh}' is not an SSH destination (a host alias or user@host)
tui_config_problems_size_invalid: '{value}' is not a size (use e.g. 512M or 4G)
